Interface StreamAdvisorChain

All Superinterfaces:
AdvisorChain
All Known Subinterfaces:
BaseAdvisorChain
All Known Implementing Classes:

public interface StreamAdvisorChain extends AdvisorChain
一系列StreamAdvisor实例负责编排对下一个链中StreamAdvisor的ChatClientRequest执行。
